entities.name: UniProt P40871 DhbE
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Bacillus subtilis 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate-AMP ligase P40871.
Activates 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate (DHB) by ATP-dependent adenylation to form an acyl-AMP intermediate for bacillibactin synthesis.
Annotated cytoplasmic; GO:0008668 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate-[aryl-carrier protein] ligase activity; GO:0019290 siderophore biosynthetic process.
Sequence is 539 aa; Pfam AMP-binding domain PF00501 at 32–393 and AMP-binding_C PF13193 at 444–519.

entities.name: Bacillibactin biosynthesis
observations: DhbE-mediated DHB adenylation is part of catecholic siderophore bacillibactin biosynthesis.

entities.name: Siderophore biosynthesis
observations: GO:0019290 annotates this exact-match protein in siderophore biosynthetic process.
